text:
Tess: Dropped a quick pass on the billing rows — focusing on where to put invoice actions, how to surface token vs cost, and what the default scope should be when someone lands. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/unique-ux-pass. PTAL before noon.
Omar: Nice direction. Quick flag: the per-row download icon at the far right gets clipped on narrower windows. Could we move the primary download into an overflow menu and keep a small PDF icon for the most common action?
Linh: Overflow + small primary icon sounds good. For compact layouts I'd hide the icon and rely on the overflow to avoid wrapping. Also propose a sticky footer bulk action on mobile when rows are selected.
Priya: Sticky footer is useful on touch, but on desktop I'd rather header bulk actions. We should A/B header vs footer for engagement. Add telemetry `billing.bulk_download.placement` with values `header|footer`.
Tess: Agree on A/B. Also debating default scope: research suggests "remember last-used scope" reduces confusion more than role-based defaults. Can we implement remembered-per-user first, role fallback second?
Omar: Yes — and show a small persistent crumb: "Scope: Project (remembered)" so it's discoverable. First-run tooltip can explain the behavior.
Linh: Accessibility nit: the scope toggle contrast is too low when inactive. Current token is near-white on white. We need at least 3:1 for non-text UI elements or increase to 4.5:1 for text. Also add a visible focus ring for keyboard users.
DesignBot: accessibility-scan: .scope-toggle contrast=fail; .download-btn missing aria-label; bulk-button needs aria-hidden toggle when not visible.
Priya: Microcopy: change all "Download" labels to "Download PDF invoice" and have a separate "Export CSV ledger" action in the header overflow. People confuse CSV vs invoice.
Omar: Token breakdown chart: we should not mix units. Options: 1) show tokens only and offer a cost overlay on hover, 2) dual-axis with tiny unit chips, or 3) allow toggling metric. Research favours toggle for accountants.
Linh: Toggle is simplest for users. If we show both, use dual-axis clearly labeled and color pills: teal = tokens, indigo = USD. Also collapse inline labels below 480px and rely on keyboard-accessible tooltips.
Tess: Good. For inline numbers use compact formatting (e.g., 3.2M tokens) at small sizes and reveal the full number in the tooltip/aria-description.
DesignBot: accessibility-scan: stacked-bar segments need `aria-describedby` linking to a readable label; hover-only tooltips must be keyboard-triggerable.
Priya: Row affordances: tab order should be checkbox -> invoice link -> amount -> actions. When a user selects rows, enable the header bulk action; for touch show sticky footer. Add `aria-pressed` for selected row toggles.
Omar: Where to put the bulk download CTA in the header? Left side is more visible but may conflict with breadcrumbs. Right side is standard for actions. Let's include both in the A/B and record `placement:left|right`.
Linh: Also ensure the download button's aria-label reads the invoice id, e.g., `aria-label=\"Download PDF for INV-2024-0999\"`. Helps screen-reader users scan fast.
Tess: Good examples. I'll update the figma with: overflow pattern for compact, small PDF icon for quick action, header-left and header-right bulk mocks, sticky-footer for mobile, and the scope-crumb pattern.
Priya: One more microcopy: tooltip on token chips should read "API tokens consumed" not just "tokens". Keep the shorter label in tight UI but full copy in tooltips.
DesignBot: accessibility-scan pending after color token bump. Also recommend `aria-live` announcements for bulk download success/failure: "Downloaded 3 invoices" / "Failed to download 1 invoice".
Omar: Telemetry: in addition to placement, emit `billing.denom.toggle` and `billing.scope.remembered` when relevant.
Tess: I'll add the telemetry keys and the A/B flags to the spec. Expect updated frames by tomorrow morning. If no objections we'll schedule the header-left vs header-right A/B next sprint.
Linh: Sounds great. Small follow-up: ensure chart legends use the system 6px corner radius and consistent badge sizes.
Priya: And make sure the focus ring is 3px, not 2px, per the a11y guidelines.
Tess: Thanks all — will push updates and share the new figma link when ready. :thumbsup:
